msItem.incipit: -3rوالامام ابى القاسم الرافعي رحمه الله ذى التحقيقات وهو كثير الفوائد عمدة في في تحقيق المذهب معتمد للمفتى وغيره من اولى الرغبات
msItem.explicit: -95vاعتبرت الاستطاعة بعده ومن فاته الوقوف تحلل بطواف وكذا سعي وحلق وفيهما قول وعليه دم قضاء
msItem.note: Appears to be a composite codex; different hands; loose folios (ff 5-7) attached to the codex; ff 83-84 are misplaced; between ff 5v and 6r some pages are missing

item.q: تمت الربع الاول يو[كذا] الاحد في وقت الفجر
Fā'ida about the qualities of Jesus.

الحافظ محرى المذو...ابو زكريا محي الدين يحى بن شرف مرئى النووي الشافعي تغمده الله برحمته امين وصلى الله على سيدنا محمد واله وصحبه وسلم فائده مسائل المنهاج احدى واربعون الف مسئلة فائدة جملة كتب المنهاج ثلاثة وسبعون كتابا والابواب ثلاثة وخمسون بابا والفصول مأتان وثلاثة عشر فصلا والفروع عشر وجملة قلت مائة واربعة وسبعون والله تمت
item.note: List of the numbers of chapters and sections of the Minḥāǧ al-Ṭālibīn

item.q: Several Fawā'id about moral merit of the dogs, divorce according to ḥanafī maḏhab, prayer on the Prophet, measures of cereals (kīl), inheritance, best ways to earn a living, invocation against nightmares, prosternations while reciting the Quran, pregnancy, tooth cleaning, words to express quantities, trade of animals (elephants horns, tiger skin, cats, donkeys), categories of women with which the marriage is licit, gall nuts to produce ink, the realm of Ǧabārūt, the creation of Adam, merits of acquiring knowledge, duration of pregnancy in humans and animals, permissibility for the teacher to quit teaching on Friday, possibility of marrying non licit women in Paradise for Muslims (mentioning al-Ramlī), conditions when sacrifying an animal is not licit, ḥiǧāb to cure someone possessed by a ǧinn, invocation to protect oneself from the balā' descending during the month of Ṣafar, different kinds of siwāk, explanation of the meaning of the words subbūḥ and quddūs, rite to be performed the night before marriage, visions of women in the Hell during the Miʻrāǧ, teaching on Friday, relation of the qibla with the Throne of God, worsening of the conditions of the soul while getting old, merits of sūrat al-Fātiḥa, Tarāwīḥ prayer, kind of beings not generated by a father and a mother, invocation to be ricited during funerals, merits of the last rakʻāt of Maġrib and ʻIšā' prayers,
Incipit: غسمه الله فى بحر سنه سلمه الله من وسوسته غمسه الله فى بحر شينه شاهده الله كل اياته
item.note: Loose folio, smaller than the ones of the codex; the text is a poem in hā' and includes an invocation for every letter of the Arabic alphabet; the order is not the one of the abǧad.

item.q: Fawā'id about difficult chilbirth (quoting al-Ṯaʻālibī), temporary wedding (mutʻa), the rooster and the aḏān (referring to al-Barmāwī and al-Ġazālī), master-disciple economical relation, the Era of the Daǧǧāl, jurisprudence about donations (referring to al-Ġazālī and Ibn al-Ṣalāh al-Šahrazūrī).
item.note: Fawā'id are separated by lines and written in different directions.

item.q: Fā'ida about the merit of devotional deeds.
item.note: Almost unreadable, ink faded away; the fā'ida is written next to other words, completely unreadable.
